items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Did Larry have a big band then? ... Jimmy Larry had the band.

ctx.x: Hmm? Go ahead, nothing. Did what? Nothing. I'm about to fall asleep. I'm tired, I was out late last night. You tired? Yeah. Yeah. Shots worked on their job for us too. Mmhmm. Mmhmm. Mmhmm.
Yeah this was a hard job to build for the trumpet players. Mmhmm. Mmhmm. Now, um, did Larry have a big band then?
